title: Request For Information: Nuclear Command, Control, and Communications (NC3) Very Low Frequency/Low Frequency (VLF/LF) system
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE NUCLEAR WEAPON CENTER.NUCLEAR COMMAND, CONTROL & COMMUNICATION WEAPON.FA8735 NUCLEAR NTW DIV AFNWC PZHN
detail_text: The United States Air Force Materiel Command (AFMC), Air Force Nuclear Weapon Center (AFNWC), in support of the Very Low Frequency Enterprise Program Office, is seeking information on Industry improvements and capabilities from interested contractors who could procure, integrate, and develop the Nuclear Command, Control, and Communications (NC3) Very Low Frequency/Low Frequency (VLF/LF) system, its ancillary components, and develop, procure, and integrate portable configurations for current and future U.S. military aircraft. Please refer to the attached Request for Information (RFI) for more details. Please note that this RFI is for market research purposes only and no contract award will result from this posting.
